system.description:
11th Level Clan Feature

Your ability to manifest lightning release in the form of a neon light that is a color of your choice, represented by the data you can integrate with, has reached a new height, allowing you to even extract information from an enemies chakra network almost as if it were a mechanical system.

Creatures under the effect of the Firewalled condition, present additional information to you passively. Select one of the following pieces of information that is displayed as if they were followed by neon signs.

One of the creature's attack bonuses.

| Data Leak / [Elemental] / A Data Leaking creature gains vulnerability to one damage type of the inflictors choice. / A Data Leaking Creature increases the cost of jutsu they cast by +8. / Once the affected creatures takes damage of the type, they gained vulnerability to as a result of this condition, they can make a Constitution saving throw vs the Genwa’s highest jutsu save DC. On a success, this condition is dispelled. |

One of the creature's Save DCs.

The creature's lowest saving throw type.

The creatures current hit points.

The creatures current chakra points.

Number of Tenacity Die/ Legendary Resistances.
